summary: Nu Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 6, 2026, furnishing proxy materials for its annual general meeting (AGM) scheduled for August 6, 2026. The filing is a routine proxy statement soliciting shareholder votes on ordinary resolutions under Cayman Islands law. It details record date, share ownership (4,830,484,570 ordinary shares outstanding), voting rights (Class A: 1 vote per share; Class B: 20 votes per share), and quorum requirements. There are no special transactions, activist campaigns, or strategic changes. As a routine AGM notice, this does not qualify as a special situation.
